# French legal APIs for AI agents (x402, USDC on Base)

Two HTTP APIs. POST JSON, pay USDC on Base, get the result. Offline compute. No INSEE/Sirene fetch. No scrape.

## E-invoice calendar + L441-10 + checksums — $0.01

Base: https://fr-legal-kit.monnet-yanis1.workers.dev
Docs: https://fr-legal-kit.monnet-yanis1.workers.dev/llms.txt
Manifest: https://fr-legal-kit.monnet-yanis1.workers.dev/.well-known/x402.json

POST /v1/einvoice-who
{"size":"micro"|"pme"|"eti"|"ge"}
France 2026-09-01: all VAT-liable firms must RECEIVE e-invoices. GE/ETI must EMIT. PME/micro emit 2027-09-01.

POST /v1/late-penalties
{"amount_ttc":1200,"days_late":18,"bce_refi_pct":2.4}

POST /v1/check-siret  {"siret":"14 digits"}
POST /v1/check-iban   {"iban":"FRxx..."}
POST /v1/due-date     {"invoice_date":"2026-04-01","net_days":30}
POST /v1/tva-rate     {"rate":"standard"}
POST /v1/holidays     {"year":2026}
POST /v1/payment-term-max  {"invoice_date":"2026-09-07"}
POST /v1/mention-fields    {"kind":"facture","tva_franchise_293b":true}
POST /v1/vat-key           {"siren":"404833048"}
POST /v1/penalty-text      {"bce_refi_pct":2.4}
POST /v1/franchise-293b    {"activity":"services","ca_n1_eur":20000}
POST /v1/dunning-steps     {"due_date":"2026-09-07"}
POST /v1/open-days         {"from":"2026-04-03","to":"2026-04-07"}
POST /v1/invoice-numbering {"last_number":"F-2026-0042"}
POST /v1/amount-words      {"amount_eur":12.4}
POST /v1/alsace-holidays   {"year":2026}
MCP POST /mcp  (tools/list free; tools/call $0.01)

## Invoice/quote legal mention blocks — $0.02

Base: https://fr-invoice-mentions.monnet-yanis1.workers.dev
Docs: https://fr-invoice-mentions.monnet-yanis1.workers.dev/llms.txt
POST /v1/mentions  seller facts → collable 293 B / L441-9 / L441-10 text.

Pay: x402 exact USDC, network eip155:8453, facilitator https://facilitator.payai.network
Human landing: https://cartonpliant.github.io/fr-legal-agents/
